curated.tagline: Auto-rename and index Wayland screenshots with a vision model
curated.description: Captions each Omarchy screenshot with one low-detail OpenRouter vision request, files it into a dated Library with a descriptive snake_case name, and writes a markdown index.
highlights: One vision request per image with retries and a safe fallback name
Dated YYYY/MM Library with collision-safe names
curated.architecture: Screenshot inbox → OpenRouter vision caption → dated Library + index.md
